rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3. H-3 directly supports examining braking when no obstacle is ahead and establishes the declared operational scope. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle” directly addresses the behaviour targeted by SG-3.
“Whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present in front” is supported by H-3’s hazardous event of suddenly stopping despite no obstacle ahead.
The scope matches H-3: straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, on a less frequented road, in good weather, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
No observation or control implementation mechanisms or their timing requirements are incorporated into P.
